talk.transcript: Today, I will explain the concept of renewable energy. Renewable energy comes from natural sources that replenish themselves, such as sunlight, wind, and water. These energy sources are sustainable and can be used repeatedly without the risk of depletion. Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, while wind turbines harness wind power. Hydropower utilizes flowing water to generate energy. Transitioning to renewable energy is essential for reducing greenhouse gas emissions and combating climate change.

questions.explain: 可再生能源來自自然來源。
太陽能電池板將陽光轉換為電力。
可再生能源有助於減少溫室氣體。

questions.q: Which renewable energy source uses flowing water?
questions.explain: 水力發電使用流動的水。
